availability.note: Zeekr AU MY26 X page lists RWD and AWD with a live Build & Price link (conf.zeekrlife.com/en-au/?linkCode=1581, client-rendered; a deeper fetch of it was refused by a permission check). No MY27 X announced as of 2026-11-27; the Oct/Nov MY27 update was the 7X only. Two-grade line-up confirmed by CarExpert and The Beep.

listPrice.note: Zeekr quotes $48,900 drive-away; The Beep FAQ: 'all-inclusive with no additional on-road costs', national flat figure (CarExpert https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-news/2026-zeekr-x-price-and-specs-updated-ev-gets-massive-price-cuts-1). No 'before on-road costs' list price published by Zeekr; CarExpert/Zecar/CarsGuide database pages label $48,900 as MSRP/before on-roads, but CarExpert's own Sydney drive-away then adds ~$3,018 on top (shows the database stores the drive-away figure as MSRP), so rejected in favour of the manufacturer's drive-away wording. (48900 - 958.80)/1.042 = 46,009; round-trip driveAwayPrice total 48899.53. Zeekr sells agency-direct, so no dealer delivery is bundled; whether CTP is included is unstated. Unverified against an independent on-road estimate (configurator unreadable). Re-derived 2026-11-27 for VIC rego $958.80 (was 46,084 at $880; round trip 48900.18).
